title: aidd owners --json
description: Who decides and who does the work: the humans who approve, and every agent role with what it writes and the standards it reads.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

mission.description: The config's `mission`: why the product or team exists; null when unset.

goal.description: The team's goal from the config, or null when not set.

proactive_roles.description: Roles that may suggest work nobody asked for, always as a draft Spec.

unknown_proactive_roles.description: Names in the config's `agents.proactive_roles` that match no agent role.

humans.description: The people who decide: the Approvers, the specialist pools, the owner areas, and the default team.

approvers.description: Who gives Spec approval and Merge approval.

specialist_pools.description: Each specialist pool in `owners.specialists` (such as `security`) and who is bound to it.

area_owners.description: The owner areas from `owners.paths`: path globs and who must approve a change that touches them.

paths.description: The globs of the paths this area owns.

approvers.description: Who approves a change touching those paths.

codeowners.description: Whether the config reads the repository's CODEOWNERS file as owner areas (`owners.codeowners`).

default_team.description: The team accountable for a change no area owns (`owners.default_team`); null when unset.

agent_accounts.description: The agent accounts the config names in `identities.bots`: their platform approvals never count.

agents.description: Every agent role in the team, in the loop's order.

role.description: The role's key, such as `developer` or `reviewer`.

steps.description: The loop steps the role works in, such as Specify or Implement.

lanes.description: The lanes the role takes part in, such as `fast` or `spec`.

writes.description: What the role writes, as the team pages name it.

tier.description: The model tier the role runs on by default (such as `execution`); null when the role names none.

proactive.description: Whether the config lets this role suggest work nobody asked for, always as a draft Spec.

starts_when.description: The event that starts the role's work.

standards.description: The names of the standards this role reads for the given --changed paths.

installed.description: Whether the role is installed here: its `aidd init --team` agent file is in `.claude/agents/`, or no agent file is and the plugin carries every role.

fallback.description: The role that does this role's work where it is not installed (roles.json `fallback`), or null.

standards.description: The `[[standards]]` of the config: the team's own documents and its copies of library standards, each with its type, and when each applies.

type.description: opinionated: a choice the team or company commits to. Today every `[[standards]]` entry is opinionated, since an industry standard lives only in the registry; the field stays so registry rows can join the list later.

fills.description: The open choices it answers, each `<pack or skill>:<choice>`.

library_id.description: The library standard it copies (`vendored.id`), or null for the team's own.

path.description: The repository path of the document.

when_changed.description: Path globs: the roles read it when a change touches one; empty means always.

enforced_by.description: The names of the test commands that check it.

unknown_tests.description: Names in `enforced_by` that match no declared test command.

enforcement.description: `enforced by` and the test commands that check it, or `guidance` when none does.

unknown_standard_roles.description: Role names in a standard's `roles` (other than `*`) that match no agent role.

stewards.description: Who keeps each domain pack and practice skill of aidd-team current, from the roles registry (`steward`) and each skill's front matter (`metadata.steward`): a person or a team, never an agent.

kind.description: pack: a domain pack (`domains` in the roles registry). skill: a practice skill.

id.description: The pack's slug or the practice skill's name: `aidd-team:<id>`.

steward.description: `@user`, `@org/team`, or `email:<address>`; null when none is named.

project.description: The config's `[project]` for the --changed paths (every rule without them), or null when the config has none.
The project's constraints: the stack radar, the hosting, the budget, and the rules that apply, must first.

radar.description: The stack radar in one line, such as "Stack: adopt Python; hold MongoDB".

trial.description: In use on a trial basis.

hold.description: Not for new work without an ADR and a person's decision.

compliance.description: Present when compliance is on: `[project.compliance]` names a target, or the profile is regulated.

pack.description: The domain pack that carries the control set: `aidd-team:enterprise-controls`.

rules.description: The rules whose `applies` match the paths in question, must first, then should, then may.

applies.description: Its path globs; empty for the whole repository.

check.description: The command or `[[tests]]` name that enforces it, or null.

source.description: The ADR that decided it, or null.

review_due.description: Its next review date, or null.

until.description: The last day the waiver holds.

reason.description: Why the rule cannot hold for now.

waiver.description: The waiver in force today, or null.
